configurePresets.name: clang
configurePresets.description: What the three clang presets share. clang is a choice of default, not a requirement: it is the toolchain the warning set is tuned against. Any other compiler is one cache variable away (-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=gcc or cl). Presets only state what DIFFERS from the option defaults in CMakeLists.txt.

configurePresets.name: clang-debug
configurePresets.description: Unoptimized, every check compiled in, debug logging and gem hot reload on. This is the config where a new warning is cheapest to fix.

configurePresets.name: clang-optimized
configurePresets.description: Release code generation with the assertions left in -- the config to develop and profile against. 'Optimized' is not a build type CMake ships, so its flags are spelled out here; -g costs nothing at runtime and makes a firing assert land on a line number.

configurePresets.name: clang-release
configurePresets.description: What ships. Asserts compiled out, logging down to what a user could act on, and no memory ledger -- which also takes the bookkeeping header off every allocation. MG_WERROR is off here and only here: a new compiler's new warning must not be what stops a release.

configurePresets.name: msvc
configurePresets.description: What the three MSVC presets share, mirroring the clang base. cl.exe is found on PATH rather than by absolute path, so these must be configured from a Developer Command Prompt or an IDE toolchain that has run vcvarsall -- Ninja does not set up the MSVC environment itself, unlike the Visual Studio generators. The warning set is already spelled for cl in cmake/MagicCompiler.cmake, which also hard-fails without /Zc:preprocessor: the argument-count dispatch in asserts.h and list.h does not survive the traditional preprocessor.

configurePresets.name: msvc-debug
configurePresets.description: The clang-debug settings under cl: every check compiled in, debug logging and gem hot reload on.

configurePresets.name: msvc-optimized
configurePresets.description: clang-optimized under cl: release code generation with the assertions left in. 'Optimized' is not a build type CMake ships, so its flags are spelled out here in MSVC's dialect -- /Zi is -g, and the linker needs /debug of its own to emit the PDB the compiler's debug info goes into.

configurePresets.name: msvc-release
configurePresets.description: What ships, built by cl. Asserts compiled out, logging down to what a user could act on, no memory ledger, and MG_WERROR off for the same reason it is off in clang-release.
